I don’t have personal experience, but 300 gsm (140 lb) paper is a reliable choice for soft coastal washes; heavier paper can buckle less, while lighter paper usually needs stretching. For especially wet techniques, try a rough or cold-pressed surface.

A full-sheet wash can work for a unified sky or haze, but let it dry before adding crisp details.
